root_cause: The post-merge terminalizer recognized only supabase-migration-history-(parity|canonical)- obligation IDs. The isolated current-production parity successor used supabase-current-production-ledger-parity-..., so already-applied historical migration mirrors were misclassified as unwired runtime paths after a successful protected merge.
prevention: Recognize the explicit Supabase parity obligation families migration-history-(parity|canonical), production-ledger-parity, and current-production-ledger-parity.
Keep the parity bypass gated by Candidate-Type: recovery.
Keep the historical parity path allowlist unchanged and exclude supabase/functions/** so runtime changes still require provider readback.

evaluation.expected: The terminalizer recognizes current production-ledger parity recoveries as non-runtime historical migration reconciliation while preserving the existing path allowlist and continuing to reject Supabase Edge function paths from the parity bypass.
